translations.idiomatic: At the time Jun bore heavy trust, drilled troops in Qin-chuan, and planned the two Rivers; ten-day rewards and monthly bonuses sought to make soldiers die with all their strength—expense beyond reckoning, all provided by Kai; Kai understood food and goods thoroughly, his calculations leaving nothing out; though disbursements could not be counted, surplus seemed always at hand.

sentences.zh: 吳玠為四川宣撫副使，專治戰守，于財計盈虛未嘗問，惟一切以軍期趣辦，與開異趣。

translations.literal: Wu Jie was Sichuan Pacification vice-commissioner, specializing in war and defense; he never asked about fiscal surplus or deficit, only pressing everything to meet army deadlines—at odds with Kai.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Jie was Sichuan Pacification vice-commissioner, specializing in war and defense; he never asked about fiscal surplus or deficit, only pressing everything to meet army deadlines—at odds with Kai.

sentences.zh: 玠數以餉饋不繼訴於朝，開亦自劾老憊，丐去。

translations.literal: Jie repeatedly complained to court that rations did not keep up; Kai also impeached himself as old and weary and begged to leave.
translations.idiomatic: Jie repeatedly complained to court that rations did not keep up; Kai also impeached himself as old and weary and begged to leave.

sentences.zh: 朝廷未許，乃特置四川安撫制置大使之名，命席益為之。

translations.literal: The court did not consent and specially created the post of Sichuan Pacification and Settlement Grand Commissioner, appointing Xi Yi.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not consent and specially created the post of Sichuan Pacification and Settlement Grand Commissioner, appointing Xi Yi.

sentences.zh: 益前執政，詔位宣撫司上，朝論恐未安，仍詔張浚視師荊、襄、川、陝。

translations.literal: Yi had formerly held the chief ministership; an edict placed him above the Pacification office—court opinion feared this was unsettling—and still ordered Zhang Jun to oversee armies in Jing, Xiang, Chuan, and Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Yi had formerly held the chief ministership; an edict placed him above the Pacification office—court opinion feared this was unsettling—and still ordered Zhang Jun to oversee armies in Jing, Xiang, Chuan, and Shan.

sentences.zh: 六年，罷綿州宣撫司，玠仍以宣撫治兵事，軍馬聽玠移撥，錢物則委開拘收。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the Mianzhou Pacification office was abolished; Jie still governed military affairs as Pacification commissioner; army horses were at Jie's disposal for transfer, but funds were entrusted to Kai for collection.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the Mianzhou Pacification office was abolished; Jie still governed military affairs as Pacification commissioner; army horses were at Jie's disposal for transfer, but funds were entrusted to Kai for collection.

sentences.zh: 尋除開徽猷閣待制，加玠兩鎮節鉞。

translations.literal: Soon Kai was made Attendant Gentleman of the Huaiyou Pavilion; Jie was given two frontier military commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Kai was made Attendant Gentleman of the Huaiyou Pavilion; Jie was given two frontier military commissions.

sentences.zh: 復降旨，都轉運使不當與四路漕臣同系銜，成都、潼川兩路漕臣與都轉運使坐應副軍支錢物愆期，各貶二秩。

translations.literal: Another edict said the overall transport commissioner should not share the same memorial heading as the four-circuit transport commissioners; the Chengdu and Tongchuan commissioners and the overall commissioner, for being late in supplying army funds, were each demoted two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said the overall transport commissioner should not share the same memorial heading as the four-circuit transport commissioners; the Chengdu and Tongchuan commissioners and the overall commissioner, for being late in supplying army funds, were each demoted two ranks.

sentences.zh: 朝廷故抑揚之，使之交解間隙、趣辦餉饋也。

translations.literal: The court deliberately played them off against each other to create friction at handover and hurry rations.
translations.idiomatic: The court deliberately played them off against each other to create friction at handover and hurry rations.

sentences.zh: 而開復與席益不和，抗疏乞將舊來宣撫司年計應副軍期，不許他司分擘支用。

translations.literal: Kai again clashed with Xi Yi and submitted a memorial asking that the Pacification office's annual appropriations for army deadlines not be split and spent by other agencies.
translations.idiomatic: Kai again clashed with Xi Yi and submitted a memorial asking that the Pacification office's annual appropriations for army deadlines not be split and spent by other agencies.

sentences.zh: 又指陳宣撫司截都漕運司錢，就果、閬糴米非是。

translations.literal: He also pointed out that the Pacification office seized overall transport funds and bought grain at Guo and Lang—this was wrong.
translations.idiomatic: He also pointed out that the Pacification office seized overall transport funds and bought grain at Guo and Lang—this was wrong.

sentences.zh: 又言應副吳玠軍須，紹興四年總為錢一千九百五十五萬七千餘緡，五年視四年又增四百二十萬五千餘緡。

translations.literal: He also said that supplying Wu Jie's army in the fourth year of Shaoxing totaled 19.557 million strings, and the fifth year added 4.205 million more than the fourth.
translations.idiomatic: He also said that supplying Wu Jie's army in the fourth year of Shaoxing totaled 19.557 million strings, and the fifth year added 4.205 million more than the fourth.

sentences.zh: 蜀今公私俱困，四向無所取給，事屬危急，實甚可憂，氣許以茶馬司奏計詣闕下，盡所欲言。

translations.literal: Shu now is strained public and private, with no supply from any quarter—the situation is critically dangerous and truly worrisome; he was permitted to bring the Tea and Horse Commission's accounts to court and speak fully.
translations.idiomatic: Shu now is strained public and private, with no supply from any quarter—the situation is critically dangerous and truly worrisome; he was permitted to bring the Tea and Horse Commission's accounts to court and speak fully.

sentences.zh: 朝廷既知開與玠及席益有隙，乃詔開赴行在，以李迨代之。

translations.literal: The court, knowing Kai was at odds with Jie and Xi Yi, ordered Kai to the traveling palace and replaced him with Li Dai.
translations.idiomatic: The court, knowing Kai was at odds with Jie and Xi Yi, ordered Kai to the traveling palace and replaced him with Li Dai.

sentences.zh: 會疾作不行，提舉江州太平觀。

translations.literal: Illness came on and he could not go; he was made director of the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Illness came on and he could not go; he was made director of the Taiping Abbey in Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 七年，復右文殿修撰、都大主管川陝茶馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was again made Academician of the Youwen Hall and overall director of Chuan-Shaan tea and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was again made Academician of the Youwen Hall and overall director of Chuan-Shaan tea and horses.

sentences.zh: 開已病，累疏丐去，詔從所乞，提舉太平觀。

translations.literal: Kai was already ill and repeatedly memorialized to leave; an edict granted his request and made him director of the Taiping Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: Kai was already ill and repeatedly memorialized to leave; an edict granted his request and made him director of the Taiping Abbey.

sentences.zh: 十一年卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：秦檜執國柄，其誤宋大計，固無以議為也。

translations.literal: The commentary says: Qin Hui held the reins of state—his mistake in the great plan of Song cannot be debated.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: Qin Hui held the reins of state—his mistake in the great plan of Song cannot be debated.

sentences.zh: 張九成之策，胡銓之疏，忠義凜然。

translations.literal: Zhang Jiucheng's policy essay and Hu Quan's memorial stand with loyalty and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jiucheng's policy essay and Hu Quan's memorial stand with loyalty and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 廖剛請復用德望之人，豈苟阿時好者哉？

translations.literal: Liao Gang's plea to restore men of virtue—was he one who curried favor with the times?
translations.idiomatic: Liao Gang's plea to restore men of virtue—was he one who curried favor with the times?

sentences.zh: 李迨、趙開所謂可使治其賦也歟？

translations.literal: Were Li Dai and Zhao Kai not those of whom it is said, "Let them manage the revenue"?
translations.idiomatic: Were Li Dai and Zhao Kai not those of whom it is said, "Let them manage the revenue"?
